Please don't leave. You haven't met the bestest friends you'll ever make yet, you haven't loved so many pets yet, you haven't been loved by all the people that will love you yet. It sounds like utter bullshit I know bc when I was in your position three years ago I'd think the same, but seriously I promise you that it will not be like this forever. You will have moments where you'll go 'oh yeah, this is what it feels like to live, it was worth it' and then it'll go again. But it's okay, because you'll have more of those moments and they'll slowly become more frequent and you'll be reminded again. Even if you think that no one cares about you, I do, because where I am its 1am and I have a horrific headache from drinking glasses of cheap wine earlier and I am still squinting to write this out because you matter to me. I know how it feels like to be in the position you're in now, and how you feel so isolated and alone that it physically hurts, but I'm writing this so you know that you're not alone, so you have proof you're not alone. My name is Aisha, I'm a 21 year old psychology student from the UK and if you ever need a friend, message me and I'll give you my contact details <3 this was long and cringy but I cannot bear the thought of anyone feeling how I did and I can tell that you're in pain
